messages:
Priya Rao: Quick sync — CedarTech signed off to go live Tue 10AM PT, but legal still needs final signoff on the customer quote and release. Need a verified one-sentence quote and approval by EOD tomorrow. Also we should finalize the webinar panel and the benchmark narrative (latency + cost slide).

Mira Chen: Got it. Who's owning the quote ask? I can reach out to J. Patel at CedarTech.

Tony Alvarez: I'll own the webinar lineup. Proposal: Mira/Nicole on product, CedarTech PM for customer on panel, 20 min demo + 15 min Q&A. Need slide with benchmark numbers and a short method note.

Azra Khan: For inbound leads, route registrants who select 'interested in pilot' to SDR queue A; others to nurture. Can we add a hidden field to the sign-up form for 'current inference provider'? helps segmentation.

Priya Rao: @Mira please confirm if CedarTech can do a 30-60s recorded quote or we need a text version. @Azra good call — hidden field OK. @Tony benchmark numbers: use 95th pct latency, tokens/sec, and estimated $/1M tokens.

Sam Li: LegalBot flagged two items in the standard quote template: (1) remove 'unlimited' performance claim, (2) add customer-provided quote consent line. I've pasted suggested minimal consent language below:

Sam Li: ```By providing this statement, CedarTech grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote in marketing materials.```

LegalBot: Automated check: change (1) to 'subject to workload profile' and include consent clause. Please upload the final quote to /marketing/case-quotes for tracking.

Mira Chen: Reached out to J. Patel, they can do a text quote by EOD today. Draft suggested: 'Redwood's API cut our inference costs by ~40% and reduced tail latency for our conversational agents.' Thoughts?

Tony Alvarez: Love it. Minor tweak: replace 'cut' with 'reduced' and add specific metric if possible — e.g., 'reduced average inference cost per 1k tokens by 40%'.

Priya Rao: Nice. Mira, can you confirm numbers? If they don't want specifics, we publish the text and mark as 'anonymized metric available on request'.

Azra Khan: For post-launch routing: webinar registrants -> tag 'webinar-cedartech-2026' in HubSpot, create list for SDRA. I'll set automation on publish.

Sam Li: Deadline checklist: final quote (text or recording) — EOD today; legal approval — EOD tomorrow; slide deck w/ benchmark + method note — Mon 9AM; webinar dry run — Mon 4PM. Can everyone ack which item they own?

Mira Chen: I'll get quote text today. ack quote.

Tony Alvarez: I'll produce slide deck and run dry run. ack slides + dry run.

Azra Khan: I'll set up form field, hubspot tags, and routing automation. ack routing.

LegalBot: Reminder: include customer's company logo upload permission. See policy link: https://redwood.internal/legal/marketing-permissions

Priya Rao: Great — triage complete. If quote arrives, @LegalBot please run the quick consent check and ping me for final OK. :thumbsup:
